title: Poestenkill Flock rejection request reconciliation
summary: Request #1895 confirms that the best-supported current state remains a rejected Rensselaer County Sheriff's Office proposal for Flock readers in Poestenkill, with no reviewed evidence establishing a later local deployment; primary record recovery remains incomplete.

sources.title: Residents question proposal for automatic license plate reader at Poestenkill intersection
Poestenkill rejects sheriff's office proposal for license plate readers at Town Hall
Calls mount to remove Flock Safety cameras in Troy

data.question: What current public evidence establishes the status of the Rensselaer County Sheriff's Office Flock proposal in Poestenkill, and has any later Poestenkill deployment been established?
data.method: Reconciled current repository material and the existing canonical Poestenkill investigation target against the Town of Poestenkill Town Board agenda/minutes index and contemporary/later Times Union reporting.
data.framework: Keep proposal, approval, rejection, installation, activation, and later alternate-site deployment as separate states. Preserve a rejected proposal as a negative deployment result until stronger evidence contradicts it.
data.scope: Public organizational and municipal records for the Poestenkill Flock proposal; no private-person enrichment.
findings: The Rensselaer County Sheriff's Office proposed a Flock Safety automatic license plate reader on municipal property facing the Routes 355/351 intersection and presented the proposal at the November 13, 2025 Town Board meeting.
The Poestenkill Town Board later rejected the sheriff's proposal in December 2025 after public opposition.
March 2026 reporting continued to describe Poestenkill as having rejected the Flock plan; no reviewed evidence established a later alternate Poestenkill deployment.

The Town of Poestenkill currently publishes a 2025 Town Board records index containing November 13 and December 11 agenda/minutes entries, but the linked minute PDFs were not reliably retrievable in this run.
conclusions: The best-supported current classification is rejected proposal / no Poestenkill deployment established.
The existing canonical investigation target should be reused rather than minting a duplicate request-specific target.
recommendations: Recover the official November 13 and December 11 minute text plus the formal rejection letter.
Recover the proposed agreement, quote, site plan, DCJS grant materials, RCSO/town/NYSDOT/Flock correspondence, and any later alternate-site proposal before closing request #1895.
counterarguments: A later alternate Poestenkill placement could exist without appearing in the reviewed public reporting or currently accessible town index.
limitations: The linked official minute PDFs were not reliably retrievable in this run, so their exact text is not represented as a verified claim.
No native RCSO/Flock contract, audit, grant, or correspondence export was recovered.
unresolved: What exact written instrument memorialized the rejection?
What DCJS award or proposed funding supported the request?
Was any alternate Poestenkill site pursued after the December 2025 rejection?
